main.clm_claim: Adjudicated insurance claims per encounter with billed, allowed and paid amounts, patient responsibility and status; answers what was claimed and reimbursed.
main.clm_claim_line: Individual procedure lines on a claim with units and billed versus allowed amounts; answers what services were billed on a claim.
main.clm_claim_submitted: Claims as first submitted, before adjudication, with submission date and billed amount; answers what has been sent to payers and is awaiting a decision.
main.clm_denial: Claims rejected by a payer, with reason, appeal date and whether the denial was overturned; answers which claims were turned down and why.
main.clm_remittance: Payments actually received from payers for claims, with date, check number and amount; answers what money insurers sent us and when.
main.enc_diagnosis: Diagnosis codes recorded on each patient encounter, in sequence, flagging the primary one; answers what conditions were diagnosed during a visit.
main.enc_encounter: Patient visits and admissions with provider, facility, admission and discharge dates, length of stay and type; answers when and where patients were seen.
main.enc_procedure: Procedures performed during an encounter, by which provider and when; answers what treatments or services a patient received.
main.mbr_eligibility: Coverage periods per member with tier and premium; answers who is currently covered and under what plan level.
main.mbr_member: Enrolled health plan members with birth year, sex, payer and enrolment status; answers who the patients or members are.
main.org_facility: Hospitals and clinics with bed count and place-of-service type; answers where care is delivered.
main.org_provider: Physicians and practitioners with NPI, name and specialty taxonomy; answers who the doctors and clinicians are.
main.org_provider_facility: Which providers are affiliated with which facilities and since when; answers where each doctor practises.
main.qm_measure: Catalogue of clinical quality measures with code, title and steward; answers which quality standards are tracked.
main.qm_measure_result: Quality measure performance per provider per period as numerator, denominator and rate; answers how well providers score on quality standards.
main.ref_denial_reason: Reference list of claim denial reason codes and whether each can be appealed; answers what a denial reason means.
main.ref_dx_code: Reference list of diagnosis codes with description, chapter and chronic flag; answers what a diagnosis code means and whether it is a chronic condition.
main.ref_payer: Insurance payers and plan types; answers which insurers cover members and pay claims.
main.ref_place_of_service: Reference list of place-of-service codes such as office, inpatient or emergency; answers what kind of setting a visit took place in.
main.ref_proc_code: Reference list of procedure codes with description, category and relative value units; answers what a procedure code means and its weight.
main.rx_drug: Drug catalogue with NDC, brand and generic names and specialty flag; answers which medications exist and whether they are generic or specialty.
main.rx_fill: Pharmacy dispensing events per prescription with fill date, ingredient cost and copay; answers which medicines were handed out and what they cost.
main.rx_prescription: Prescriptions written for members by prescribers, with drug, quantity and days supply; answers what medications were prescribed to whom.
main.v_chronic_cohort: Members diagnosed with chronic conditions and the condition codes; answers which patients live with long-term illnesses.
main.v_claim_denial_rate: Denied versus total claims per payer; answers which insurers reject claims most often.
main.v_generic_dispensing: Fill counts and ingredient cost by generic drug name; answers how often generic medicines are dispensed and what they cost.
main.v_readmission: Inpatient discharges used to detect patients readmitted soon after leaving; answers which patients came back to hospital shortly after discharge.
